name: entrust
description: Orchestrate subagents in Claude Code or Codex: agree a plan, delegate scoped tasks, verify independently and synthesise attributable results. Adapters run external Codex agents with per-call rights, evidence gates and receipts, external Claude agents through `claude -p`, and external workers or coordinators through the selected model-family adapter; helpers clean up, advise, run swarms and turn your sessions into feedback on a skill.
